profile.headline: C++/Swift Software Engineer @ Salesforce | Computer Science Degree
profile.summary: With over 10 years of experience, I am a dedicated C++ and Swift developer who focuses on creating robust systems-level libraries and intuitive user interfaces for Apple platforms. I have a strong track record of writing performant code and am highly adaptable to new technologies and IDEs, ensuring a seamless and efficient development workflow.

positions.title: C++ Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered and maintained a core C++ library as a key member of a large agile team, which served as the backend for the Salesforce Field Service mobile applications on both iOS and Android.
- Developed and optimized a new data priming system, significantly reducing app loading times and enhancing performance for field agents in low-connectivity environments.
- Authored comprehensive integration tests for the iOS client, ensuring code quality and preventing regressions across critical app workflows.
- Enhanced logging systems to dramatically improve diagnostic capabilities and expedite the debugging of complex field issues.
- Maintained and extended the Jenkins-based build system, implementing new features like a version tagging system to streamline release management and deployment.

positions.title: iOS/macOS Software Engineer, Messages App
positions.description:
- Contributed to a small, cross-functional team to develop the user interface for inline replies
- Engineered and shipped the macOS Menu Bar UI for SharePlay
- Self taught Swift and iOS/macOS app development, leveraging skills to build and deliver new features.
- Maintained and updated existing Messages features, ensuring seamless compatibility with the latest iOS and macOS releases, and oversaw a large suite of automated tests to uphold product quality.

positions.title: iOS/macOS Software Engineer, Maps app
positions.description:
- Contributed to the development of the core 3D rendering engine for Apple Maps, specializing in low-level graphics code using OpenGL and Metal.
- Spearheaded the design and implementation of a new, standalone 2D icon rendering system from the ground up, utilizing CoreGraphics 2D and Cairo.
- Partnered directly with designers to create a system that enabled real-time asset changes, reducing the design-to-development cycle from hours to minutes.
- Automated boilerplate C++ code generation based on JSON data, significantly improving developer productivity and reducing manual errors.

positions.title: GPU Tools Engineer
positions.description: Internship for Apple working in the IMG Tools department for the summer using my skills and knowledge of graphics, programming, and time management.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

projects.title: Illuminate
projects.description:
Role: Graphics Programmer, Tech Director, Associate Producer

A 3D poetic experience in a snowy wonderland.

projects.title: Glo
projects.description:
Role: Graphics Programmer, Producer

Glo was my Sophomore project with a team of 3 other programmers. We created a 2D top down multiplayer shooter. The engine used DirectX 9 for graphics and FMOD for audio. We supported up to four players on a single screen using Xbox controllers and the mouse.

I worked particularly on the graphics engine, which included UI elements and sprite management.
